external_editor.description: Name of a text editor executable (e.g., vim, nano). Falls back to $EDITOR if empty.

force_builtin_editor.description: If true, forces the use of the builtin console editor regardless of other settings.

import_old_db.description: If true, nodau will attempt to import notes from the 0.2.x database on startup.

edit_autocreate.description: If true, allows creating new notes via the edit command if the name doesn't exist.
